quests.instruction: Is 20 an odd number or an even number?
quests.hint: Try to share 20 things between two friends equally -- does anyone get a leftover?
quests.explanation: 20 can be split into two equal groups with nothing left over, so 20 is Even!
quests.funFact: You can always split an even number perfectly in half!

quests.instruction: Which number is greater: 48 or 27?
quests.hint: Line the numbers up on a number line in your head -- further right is bigger.
quests.explanation: 48 is greater than 27 -- when counting up, 48 comes later!
quests.funFact: If you multiply 48 by 10, it becomes 480!

quests.instruction: What number continues the pattern: 10, 12, 14, 16, __?
quests.hint: Look at how much bigger each number is than the one before it -- that jump stays the same every time.
quests.explanation: Each number jumps up by 2, so after 16 comes 16 + 2 = 18!
quests.funFact: If you add 0 to 18, it stays exactly the same: 18!

quests.instruction: There are 3 groups of ten and 5 more. How many in total?
quests.hint: 3 groups of ten is the same as counting by tens 3 times.
quests.explanation: 3 groups of ten make 30, plus 5 more makes 35!
quests.funFact: The number 35 is an odd number!

quests.instruction: Look at the number and find the matching word!
quests.hint: Count up to 21 in your head, saying each number word as you go.
quests.explanation: The numeral 21 is written in words as "Twenty-One" -- that's its name!
quests.funFact: In math, knowing how to read words like 'Twenty-One' is just as important as knowing the digits!

quests.instruction: Is 23 an odd number or an even number?
quests.hint: Try to share 23 things between two friends equally -- does anyone get a leftover?
quests.explanation: 23 cannot be split into two equal groups -- there's always one left over, so 23 is Odd!
quests.funFact: Odd numbers always end in 1, 3, 5, 7, or 9!

quests.instruction: There are 2 groups of ten and 8 more. How many in total?
quests.hint: 2 groups of ten is the same as counting by tens 2 times.
quests.explanation: 2 groups of ten make 20, plus 8 more makes 28!
quests.funFact: The number 28 has two digits: a 2 in the tens place and a 8 in the ones place!

quests.instruction: What number continues the pattern: 4, 9, 14, 19, __?
quests.hint: Look at how much bigger each number is than the one before it -- that jump stays the same every time.
quests.explanation: Each number jumps up by 5, so after 19 comes 19 + 5 = 24!
quests.funFact: If you count up by ones, 24 comes right after 23!

quests.instruction: Which number is the greatest: 24, 49, or 20?
quests.hint: Compare them two at a time, then keep the bigger one.
quests.explanation: Out of 24, 49, and 20, the number 49 is the greatest!
quests.funFact: If you count backwards, 49 comes just before 50!

quests.instruction: Which number is the greatest: 34, 35, or 22?
quests.hint: Line all three numbers up in counting order first.
quests.explanation: Out of 34, 35, and 22, the number 35 is the greatest!
quests.funFact: Double 35 is 70! Because 35 + 35 = 70.

quests.instruction: What number continues the pattern: 6, 11, 16, __?
quests.hint: Look at how much bigger each number is than the one before it -- that jump stays the same every time.
quests.explanation: Each number jumps up by 5, so after 16 comes 16 + 5 = 21!
quests.funFact: If you add 1 to 21, you get 22!

quests.instruction: Read the word and find the matching number!
quests.hint: Sound the word out slowly, then count that many fingers to check.
quests.explanation: "Twenty-Six" is how we say the number 26 in English, so 26 is the digit that matches!
quests.funFact: If you add 1 to 26, you get 27!

quests.instruction: What number continues the pattern: 9, 14, 19, __?
quests.hint: The pattern counts up by 5 each time. What comes after 19?
quests.explanation: Each number jumps up by 5, so after 19 comes 19 + 5 = 24!
quests.funFact: If you multiply 24 by 10, it becomes 240!

quests.instruction: Which number is greater: 44 or 21?
quests.hint: Line the numbers up on a number line in your head -- further right is bigger.
quests.explanation: 44 is greater than 21 -- when counting up, 44 comes later!
quests.funFact: If you add 0 to 44, it stays exactly the same: 44!

quests.instruction: Which word describes position number 11 in a line?
quests.hint: Think of a race -- this word describes exactly which place a runner finished in.
quests.explanation: Position 11 in a line is called the "Eleventh" position -- ordinal words describe order, not amount!
quests.funFact: You use the word 'Eleventh' to show someone's place in a line or a race!

quests.instruction: Look at the number and find the matching word!
quests.hint: Read the numeral 44 out loud -- what word do you say?
quests.explanation: The numeral 44 is written in words as "Forty-Four" -- that's its name!
quests.funFact: Did you know? The math word 'Forty-Four' is spelled with exactly 9 letters!

quests.instruction: Which number is greater: 40 or 44?
quests.hint: Compare the digits from left to right: which number has more value?
quests.explanation: 44 is greater than 40 -- when counting up, 44 comes later!
quests.funFact: The number 44 is an even number!

quests.instruction: There are 3 groups of ten and 5 more. How many in total?
quests.hint: 3 groups of ten is the same as counting by tens 3 times.
quests.explanation: 3 groups of ten make 30, plus 5 more makes 35!
quests.funFact: The number 35 has two digits: a 3 in the tens place and a 5 in the ones place!

quests.instruction: Which number is greater: 49 or 27?
quests.hint: Picture counting all the way up -- whichever number you'd reach later is the answer.
quests.explanation: 49 is greater than 27 -- when counting up, 49 comes later!
quests.funFact: If you count up by ones, 49 comes right after 48!

quests.instruction: Read the word and find the matching number!
quests.hint: Break the word into parts -- does it sound like a small number, a "teen", or a bigger one?
quests.explanation: "Forty-One" is how we say the number 41 in English, so 41 is the digit that matches!
quests.funFact: The word 'Forty-One' has exactly 9 letters in it!

quests.instruction: Which number is the greatest: 21, 38, or 47?
quests.hint: The greatest number is the one you'd reach last while counting up from zero.
quests.explanation: Out of 21, 38, and 47, the number 47 is the greatest!
quests.funFact: Double 47 is 94! Because 47 + 47 = 94.

quests.instruction: What number continues the pattern: 10, 20, 30, 40, __?
quests.hint: Look at how much bigger each number is than the one before it -- that jump stays the same every time.
quests.explanation: Each number jumps up by 10, so after 40 comes 40 + 10 = 50!
quests.funFact: If you add 1 to 50, you get 51!

quests.instruction: Look at the number and find the matching word!
quests.hint: Look at how many digits 25 has, then think of how that word usually sounds.
quests.explanation: The numeral 25 is written in words as "Twenty-Five" -- that's its name!
quests.funFact: In math, knowing how to read words like 'Twenty-Five' is just as important as knowing the digits!

quests.instruction: Which number is the greatest: 35, 28, or 37?
quests.hint: The greatest number is the one you'd reach last while counting up from zero.
quests.explanation: Out of 35, 28, and 37, the number 37 is the greatest!
quests.funFact: If you had 37 apples and found one more, you would have 38 apples!

quests.instruction: Read the word and find the matching number!
quests.hint: Break the word into parts -- does it sound like a small number, a "teen", or a bigger one?
quests.explanation: "Twenty-Four" is how we say the number 24 in English, so 24 is the digit that matches!
quests.funFact: Double 24 is 48! Because 24 + 24 = 48.

quests.instruction: What number continues the pattern: 3, 8, 13, __?
quests.hint: Look at how much bigger each number is than the one before it -- that jump stays the same every time.
quests.explanation: Each number jumps up by 5, so after 13 comes 13 + 5 = 18!
quests.funFact: If you add 0 to 18, it stays exactly the same: 18!

quests.instruction: Which number is smaller: 45 or 46?
quests.hint: Compare the digits from left to right: which number has more value?
quests.explanation: 45 is smaller than 46 -- when counting up, 45 comes earlier!
quests.funFact: The number 45 is an odd number!

quests.instruction: Which word describes position number 3 in a line?
quests.hint: Count places in order: 1st, 2nd, 3rd... keep going until you reach position 3.
quests.explanation: Position 3 in a line is called the "Third" position -- ordinal words describe order, not amount!
quests.funFact: You use the word 'Third' to show someone's place in a line or a race!

quests.instruction: Is 41 an odd number or an even number?
quests.hint: Look at the very last digit of 41 -- is it 0, 2, 4, 6, or 8?
quests.explanation: 41 cannot be split into two equal groups -- there's always one left over, so 41 is Odd!
quests.funFact: Every time you add an odd and an even number, you get an odd number!

quests.instruction: Which number is greater: 28 or 30?
quests.hint: Picture counting all the way up -- whichever number you'd reach later is the answer.
quests.explanation: 30 is greater than 28 -- when counting up, 30 comes later!
quests.funFact: The number 30 has two digits: a 3 in the tens place and a 0 in the ones place!
